ledger: skateboarder | black t-shirt, black pants, green socks, red shoes | same attire at end | lands two jumps at 00:03 and 00:09
skateboard | standard deck with two trucks and four white wheels at 00:00 | warped and split into deformed pieces at 00:09 | disappears/deforms during landings at 00:03 and 00:08-00:09

findings.invariant_violated: object permanence and rigid body integrity
findings.description: As the skateboarder comes down from the first jump, the rear half of the skateboard disappears into a blurry smudge while his back foot drops below the deck level, before the board spontaneously reforms into a complete skateboard at 00:04.

findings.invariant_violated: object permanence and rigid body integrity
findings.description: During the second jump at 00:08, the left truck assembly vanishes from the underside of the airborne skateboard. Upon landing at 00:09, the deck severely warps and splits into disconnected, deformed fragments under the skater's feet.
